WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rental_price_per_day
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_replacement_cost,
  avg_rental_price_per_day,
  avg_rental_price_per_day / AVG(avg_rental_price_per_day) OVER () AS ratio_to_plain_rating_average
FROM rating_averages
ORDER BY rating
